stories.title: MangoLiving Announces Dallas Launch of AI Powered Home Search and Agent Insights Platform
stories.simple_summary: A real estate company called MangoLiving is launching a service in Dallas that uses AI to help people search for homes and get advice from agents.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're buying or selling a home in Dallas, this might give you another tool to find properties, but it doesn't change how homes are bought and sold.

stories.title: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX (the rocket company) bought Cursor, a company that makes AI tools to help programmers write code.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: How artificial Intelligence is changing college admissions
stories.simple_summary: Colleges are starting to use AI in some way when deciding which students to admit, but the headline doesn't give details about how.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandkids applying to college, this might affect their application process, though we'd need more information to say exactly how.

stories.title: Prediction: These 3 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks Will Rise More than 30% Before 2026 Is Over
stories.simple_summary: A financial writer is predicting that three AI company stocks will go up a lot by the end of 2025.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just one person's guess about stock prices — not information you should make investment decisions on.

stories.title: EXCLUSIVE: US to tell partners they must pick sides in AI race with China
stories.simple_summary: The US government is telling its allies they need to choose whether to use AI technology from America or China, rather than both.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies and governments — it doesn't directly affect ordinary people or small businesses right now.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
stories.simple_summary: Instagram changed its logo design, and people think the new one looks confusing or odd.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Instagram, you'll see a different look, but it works the same way — this is just a cosmetic change.

stories.title: AI’s Impact on the Environment Is Absolutely Horrifying, New Paper Finds
stories.simple_summary: A research paper found that AI uses a lot of electricity and has bad environmental effects.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI technology has real costs to the planet, which is worth knowing about when companies make decisions using AI.

stories.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
stories.simple_summary: Google is letting people hide the watermark (a small mark that shows something was made by AI) on images, videos, and music created with its AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's AI to create images or videos, you can now remove the visible mark, though Google will still track it invisibly.

stories.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
stories.simple_summary: Google is allowing users to turn off the visible watermark on AI-generated content, but hidden tracking remains.
stories.why_it_matters: Similar to headline 7 — if you create with Google's AI, you can hide the obvious mark, but Google still knows what was AI-made.

stories.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is ‘for everyone’?
stories.simple_summary: Meta released an AI tool that anyone can download and use on their own computer, and Mark Zuckerberg says AI should be available to everyone, not just big companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This could mean AI tools become easier for small businesses to use, though most people won't have the computer power to run these tools themselves.

stories.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
stories.simple_summary: A startup called Kog says they found a way to make GPUs (computer chips designed for AI) work better for certain types of AI tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is technical news for engineers and companies building AI systems — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon and Alphabet’s Profits Reveal Circular Nature of A.I. Boom
stories.simple_summary: Amazon and Google are making bigger profits partly because of the AI boom, showing how AI is helping tech companies make more money.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI is becoming a real business that makes money for big companies, though it doesn't directly affect you unless you own stock or use these services.
